text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 5xx rate detected for /v2/prompt-route (canary slice). Error rate 28% over 5m, latency spike. Auto-evacuate flag may have triggered. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/alerts/4165432099 :rotating_light:
alex: Acked, I'm oncall. Can someone paste the canary deploy id and the flag name?
sam: Deploy id deploy-20260317-03:43 (canary). Flag is exp_prompt_mux v2. Observed stack traces showing kernel mismatch logs on the new endpoint.
maria: I'm pulling the request logs and infra traces now. Confirming it's correlated with canary traffic to /v2/experimental_prompt endpoint.
alex: If auto-evacuate didn't fully cut traffic we should toggle the flag immediately. Maria, is there a quick FF toggle?
maria: Flag controls are here: https://flags.redwood.internal/exp_prompt_mux. I see it still at 50% for canary slice.
alex: Executing toggle now: `curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"exp_prompt_mux","env":"canary","state":"off"}'`
ff-system: Feature flag exp_prompt_mux (env=canary) toggled to OFF by alex. Change id: ff-4165432100-1.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for deploy-20260317-03:43. Rolling back canary workers and draining connections. ETA ~2-4m.
sam: The kernel/runtime mismatch was causing KV cache crashes under parallel streams. Routing to stable model variant will avoid the new kernel path.
alex: Handing off to oncall-2: jordan (PD rotation swaps at 04:10). Jordan, you're on deck to watch the rollback and customer comms. :handshake:
jordan: Acknowledged. I'll monitor latency, errors, and open a bridge if needed. Can we get a quick count on affected customers/requests?
mike: CS reports two customers opened tickets about timeouts (account ids c-319 and c-882). From logs ~210 failed requests in the last 7m, mostly from canary slice. I'll start outreach templates if this persists.
maria: Error rate trending down after flag off — 5xx down to 3% in the last 3m. Rolling rollback completed on canary hosts at 03:51 per deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback complete for deploy-20260317-03:43. Production stable route restored.
jordan: Monitoring confirms stable route serving 100% and tail latency back to baseline. I'll keep an eye for 15m.
alex: Thanks. Opening incident ticket INC-2026-0317-ff-killflip and assigning to sam for postmortem. Sam, can you capture root cause and remediation plan (kernel detection + gating for experimental endpoints)?
sam: Will own the postmortem. Initial hypothesis: untested kernel selection path for experimental endpoint under multi-stream loads. Remediation steps: stricter canary traffic caps, runtime compatibility check in CI, and feature gating by model variant.
mike: I'll coordinate customer follow-up. Suggest sending a short note: we experienced degraded responses for requests routed to an experimental endpoint, issue mitigated by toggling the feature flag and rolling back the canary.
jordan: Confirming no further customer-facing errors. Marking incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
maria: Saved logs and traces to S3: s3://incidents/4165432100/ and added initial tags.
alex: Closing pager. Postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow, sam owner.
sam: Copy that. I'll post the draft to #postmortems and link the action items.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0317-ff-killflip created and assigned. Pager closed by alex.
